parameters.content:
## 1. Load the delivery queue

Read ready rows and skip jobs already notified. Duplicate task IDs stop the run before writes.

## 2. Check delivery materials

Require actual references and matching file metadata for every agreed criterion. Incomplete rows go to actionable feedback.

## 3. Check access and agreement

Read the authorized project and compare its current criteria. Write missing-input or owner-action feedback to the queue.

## 4. Resume a job or prepare one

Top: verify an existing saved job. Bottom: persist and read back the exact request before preparing. Preserve saved IDs and request data when retrying.

## 5. Save the handover result

Write the verified job ID and operational state back to the same task row. Only a prepared, unnotified job continues.

## 6. Remind the responsible team

Send internal review references, then mark the confirmed reminder. Normal reruns skip it; an uncertain Slack result may duplicate the reminder.

parameters.content:
### How it works
For automation consultants managing client deliverables in Google Sheets. Choose one manual operation per run: prepare validated jobs and notify an internal Slack reviewer; deliberately submit one exact reviewed job; or sync buyer decisions to the original rows. Submission also refreshes queue status. Buyer review happens in Prooftask between runs. Corrections use a new task row, preserving delivery history.

### Setup
1. Import the [sample queue](https://github.com/cognitive-emergence/prooftask-integrations/blob/main/n8n/delivery-lifecycle-example.csv). Replace fictional data with actual material references, file metadata and agreed project criteria.
2. Set spreadsheetId, numeric sheetId and slackChannelId in Configuration. Follow the [complete setup and recovery guide](https://github.com/cognitive-emergence/prooftask-integrations/blob/main/n8n/DELIVERY_LIFECYCLE.md).
3. Use the same Google Sheets OAuth credential on every Sheet node, the original project-scoped Agent Header Auth on all five Prooftask HTTP nodes, and an internal Slack bot with chat:write.
4. Run operation=prepare. Review the frozen request and originals. For operation=submit, set reviewedTaskId, reviewedRequestId, reviewedJobId and submitConfirmed=true deliberately. Reset confirmation afterwards.
5. After buyer action, run operation=sync; inspect review_next_action and review_accepted.

One execution per queue at a time. Preserve IDs after failures; sync uncertain submissions before retrying. UNKNOWN is not acceptance. No automatic buyer decision, signing or payment. Prooftask availability and pricing apply. Uses standard nodes; no sub-workflows required.

## Submit the reviewed job
Explicit operator approval must match one saved task, request and job. Current permissions apply. Success refreshes queue status; timeout requires manual reconciliation.

## 3 · Sync
Read saved jobs, including already-notified deliveries. Update only review_* columns on original tasks. Pending, corrections, exact acceptance and UNKNOWN remain distinct. Buyer reviews in Prooftask between runs.
